description: Makes the Claude Code chat calmer and more readable: right-to-left text (Arabic, Persian, Urdu and more), a broom that folds tool rows, quote reply and quote tools, and image previews. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
command.enableBroom: Turn on the broom (fold tool rows)
config.language: The language of Enhancer's control panel. Automatic follows the editor's display language, and English when Enhancer does not speak it.
config.languageEverywhere: Use Enhancer's language in the Claude Code chat (its buttons and labels), the status bar and notifications too. When off, only the control panel changes language.
config.arabic: Right-to-left text in the Claude Code chat. Text holding a letter of a right-to-left language (Arabic, Persian, Urdu and others) reads right to left, even when it starts with an English word.
config.broom: A broom button in the Claude Code chat: one click folds tool rows to their header and hides finished thinking, new ones too; another click shows them again. Each tool row also gets its own −/+.
config.broomStartsOn: The broom is on each time the Claude Code chat opens: tool rows folded and finished thinking hidden. A click on the broom lasts until the chat reloads.
config.broomButton: Show the broom button in the Claude Code message box. When hidden, each tool row's own −/+ and the broom's start state still work.
config.quoteReply: Select text in a Claude reply to get Reply and Copy. Reply keeps the selection as a card above the message box and sends it as a quote with your next message.
config.quoteTools: Copy and Select buttons in the corner of every quote in the Claude Code chat.
config.imagePreview: Thumbnails under a tool row for the image files Claude reads, writes or names; click to zoom, or open the file in the editor.
config.reapplyAfterUpdate: Apply the enhancements again when Claude Code updates or the editor starts. When off, a new Claude Code version stays original until you apply from the control panel.
config.checkForUpdates: Ask your editor's extension store (Visual Studio Marketplace or Open VSX) for the latest Enhancer version and say in the control panel when a newer one exists. Sends nothing about you.
config.ornusNews: Show one short, dismissible Ornus news item in the control panel, read from a small text file on ornus.ai. Sends nothing about you.
config.feedbackButton: Show "Send feedback" in the control panel. A message is sent to the Enhancer team only when you press Send, with only what the form shows.
